question: Unsaon pag-apela sa LZBAA kung gibalibaran ang Locational Clearance sa CPDO ug unsa ang mga requirements ug bayad sa processing fee?
answer: Sa pag-apela sa LZBAA kung gibalibaran ang Locational Clearance sa CPDO, wala nga didto sa mga nakit-an nga impormasyon sa Citizens' Charter. Wala nga didto sa mga nakit-an nga requirements ug bayad sa processing fee. [S1, S2, S3, S4, S5]

ground_truth: If a Locational Clearance is denied by the Zoning Administrator, an applicant may file a Motion for Reconsideration before the Local Zoning Board of Adjustment and Appeals (LZBAA). Requirements are: 1) Letter of Reconsideration; 2) Denial Letter; 3) Title/Lease Contract; 4) Site sketch plan with vicinity landmarks; 5) Barangay Council Resolution of No Objection; 6) Locational mapping of neighbor's consent signatories; and 7) Notarized Affidavit of Non-Objection from adjoining property owners. The processing fee is PHP 600.00, and evaluation involves TWG site inspection, committee deliberation, and LZBAA board resolution.
